title: Million Dollar Cake
description: Million dollar cake is a delicious layer cake with a light and fluffy cream cheese frosting flavored with vanilla, mandarin oranges, and pineapple.
ingredients: 1 (20 ounce) can crushed pineapple with juice
1 (3.5 ounce) package instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: Mix and bake cake mix as per package instruction for two 8-inch round layers. Let layers cool, and then split each layer in half so as to have 4 layers.

Whip cream cheese in a large bowl until soft, then gradually mix in confectioners’ sugar. Stir in pineapple with juice and drained mandarin oranges, reserving about 5 mandarin orange slices to decorate the top of cake. Mix in dry pudding mix. Fold in whipped topping.

Place one cake layer on a cake plate cut-side up; spread with frosting. Place another layer cut-side down on the first one, and top with more frosting. Repeat until all layers are used, spreading last bit of frosting on top and sides of cake. Decorate with reserved mandarin orange slices. For best results refrigerate overnight before serving.

video.description: Refreshing, sweet, and easy-to-make, this delicious dessert recipe will make you feel like a million bucks! In this video, Nicole shows you how to make a Million Dollar Cake using boxed yellow cake mix and a fruity cream cheese frosting that is layered in and around the cake. Incorporating mandarin oranges, crushed pineapple, and instant pudding into the frosting, the citrusy flavors upgrade this spongy boxed cake to something special.
